description: Land Redemption - Welkandala, Mathugama D/S Division, Kalutara District - Correction notice for the Gaz. Ex. No. 2145/52 of 18.10.2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act.
